authored_by: human-reviewable ground truth, derived from source-html and verified against the live site

matching.comment: Expectations are keyed on a distinctive source text probe, never on a generated section or element id. Ids change whenever acquisition changes; the client's words do not. An evaluator matches a recommendation to an expectation by locating the probe in that recommendation's source evidence.
matching.probe_match: case-insensitive substring of the recommendation's source evidence

pages.expected_object_rationale: A single landing page. cardinality one_per_source_url.

issues_expected.detail: The hero CTA and the 'Meet Dr. Olteanu' card both link to /meet-the-team, which returns 403. The correct page is /dental-team. This must surface as an issue and a redirect-map decision, not be silently repointed.
The hero is one slider with three slides carrying identical text and three different CTA destinations. One hero expected, not three.

structural_blocker.detail: This page must yield FIVE team_member entities. The V2 recommendation contract cannot express that: mapping-recommendations.v2 carries a single `recommended_target_object`, and entity resolution resolves one target per page. So this page is unmappable under the current data model regardless of how good the interpreter is.
structural_blocker.evidence: addons/content-migration/v2/mapping/dbvc-cc-v2-recommendation-finalizer-service.php - `recommended_target_object` is a single object, not a list
structural_blocker.consequence: The evaluator reports this page as a structural blocker and excludes it from the G-4 and G-5 scores rather than scoring an impossible task. Fixing it is a contract change, which belongs in its own slice.
structural_blocker.schema_note: target-schema.v1.json declares team_member cardinality one_per_person precisely so this shows up as a measurement, not a surprise.

g4_auto_resolve_rate.definition: recommendations with requires_review === false, over all recommendations produced for scorable pages
g4_auto_resolve_rate.faithful_to: DBVC_CC_V2_Recommendation_Finalizer_Service::build_recommendations() sets requires_review from autoAcceptMinConfidence (0.92), default_decision, reason_codes, transform warnings and value_contract status

g5_mapping_precision.definition: of the auto-accepted recommendations (requires_review === false), the fraction whose target_ref matches this file's expectation for the matched source probe. A recommendation landing on a must_not_map probe counts as wrong, as does one forcing an expected_unmapped probe into a field.
g5_mapping_precision.rationale: A wrong confident mapping costs more than an escalation: the reviewer never sees it.
